statement: The CDC group propagation service admits every durable wave its source lane presents: no wave is refused, delayed or ordered because another lane's wave is in flight. The node-wide propagation slot and every mechanism that existed to share it (per-table slice counts, the yield hold, the waiting-table queue with its lifecycles and timestamps, credits, the slice-turn wake, contention marks on the invocation, and the lane-side contention registration, release and hint handling) are removed from source, tests and documentation, not disabled. In-flight waves are bounded structurally by one per source lane; stopping the service retires every in-flight wave and arms nothing; after a refusal that attempted nothing the lane composes its next vector from the current owed tail. Coverage, receipts, acknowledgement, order within a lane and every timeout, retry count and bound value are unchanged.

constraints.statement: Bounded repair of the second measured cause of the open service quest fresh-formation-user-table-routability. Measured on the composed range-shipping and lifecycle candidates (journey job 4216bd0b on tv-dator, measurement head 9991b450d): predicate g still fails with two persistent episodes, both a single wait on the slot (one event refused 15 times over 3.05 s, one 19 times over 4.73 s with the next row of its lane waiting behind it); 1215 refusals, all busy; the slot was 82.5 percent occupied; the services lane spent 61.6 s waiting for the slot against 26.8 s in waves; no lane-backlog and no partial-row cause appears. Closing this quest does not claim the journey green.

No flag, mode, compatibility branch, alias or fallback keeps the slot or any slicing behaviour reachable; no symbol, constant, test or document of the removed mechanism survives (owner rule: no legacy, one version of any logic). History: introduced 2026-10-23 (681da1dc1, contract F2) as a memory and custody bound, not an ordering rule; fifteen behavioural patches from 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-08 tuned fairness around it without measuring sender latency; its removal was approved by the owner on 2026-11-11.

What the slot bounded stays bounded without a shared resource: at most one in-flight wave per source lane (the lane's own single flight), each carrying one vector bounded by the lane's window and SHIP_MAX_BYTES; the service owns the set of in-flight waves only to retire them on stop. No new node-wide limiter, queue, timer or fairness mechanism is introduced; a recipient that cannot keep up answers with its existing typed backpressure. If measurement shows a node-wide bound is needed, that is reported as a finding with the numbers, not built here.

Every piece of state the single slot implicitly serialized is found and either shown safe under overlapping waves or given an owner: service statistics and publication-mode diagnostics, plan capture and config refresh, retry sleep bookkeeping, the progress rotation, emitted events, and any reader of the removed fields (diagnostics, readiness, admin, tests).

No timeout, hold, retry count, cooldown, backoff or bound value changes except those deleted with the mechanism; coverage, receipts, acknowledgement and per-lane order are untouched; message-group files, the cache and the ledger are untouched; journey predicates and bounds are untouched.

Built on the composed head 589c1e2f (range-shipping candidate 596ca79c0, still in independent verification, plus the verified lifecycle candidate 5778ba12e). If the range-shipping candidate changes, this branch takes the change by merge and re-proves what it invalidates.

Reproducers are observed red on the base before the candidate is credited; independent verification on the exact candidate before landing; tests and the journey run on lab hosts through the local controller with complete evidence brought back; a failed run stays recorded as failed.
